problem_statement: Build a brand-new public FAQ / Help page from scratch at the /faq route of this DashWind (daisyUI + Tailwind) admin template. The route does not exist yet — today any request to /faq falls through the router's catch-all and redirects to the login page. Construct the whole page as a public (no-login) route, reusing the site's daisyUI design system (card, btn btn-primary, base-100/base-200/base-content color tokens, @tailwindcss/typography) and @heroicons. The page is a single static informational page (no interactive widgets). It must show a page title, a grid of help-topic cards, a 'Common Questions' section listing several questions with their answers, and a contact call-to-action. It must render without horizontal overflow on a 390px mobile viewport.
required_content: A page header with the title 'Frequently Asked Questions' and a short one-line subtitle
A grid of help-topic cards using the site's daisyUI card style — Getting Started, Billing & Plans, Security & Privacy and Troubleshooting — each with an icon, a title and a short description

A list of several question-and-answer entries where each question is a sub-heading and its answer is a paragraph beneath it (covering resetting a password, inviting your team, how billing works, data security and supported browsers)
A contact call-to-action card at the bottom with a 'Contact Support' button styled with the site's primary button class
The whole page reuses the existing daisyUI / Tailwind design system (card, btn btn-primary, base color tokens) and does not introduce a new visual language

The 'Common Questions' section must include these five question sub-headings verbatim: 'How do I reset my password?', 'Can I invite my team to the dashboard?', 'How is my billing calculated?', 'Is my data secure?' and 'Which browsers are supported?'
The data-security answer paragraph must state that the product supports two-factor authentication and keeps user data encrypted/secure

The topic cards must be titled exactly: 'Getting Started', 'Billing & Plans', 'Security & Privacy' and 'Troubleshooting'; the page subtitle reads 'Answers to the questions we hear most often about DashWind.'
design_constraints: Reuse the daisyUI components and Tailwind utility classes already used across the template (card, card-body, btn btn-primary, bg-base-100/base-200, text-base-content)
Register /faq as a PUBLIC route: add it to the Routes in App.js AND add 'faq' to the PUBLIC_ROUTES array in src/app/auth.js so checkAuth does not redirect anonymous visitors to /login
Keep the site's existing color palette and spacing; no new visual language

Use the template's existing daisyUI primary color token for the 'Contact Support' button (btn btn-primary => background/border oklch(0.4912 0.3096 275.75) i.e. the site primary purple, with primary-content text oklch(0.89824 0.06192 275.75)); do not introduce a different accent color

Body/heading text uses the base-content token oklch(0.278078 0.029596 256.848); cards use bg-base-100 (white, oklch(1 0 0)) with the daisyUI 'card bg-base-100 shadow-xl' style and rounded-2xl (16px) corners

Layout structure: an h1 page title + one-line subtitle at the top, then a responsive grid of 4 help-topic cards, then the 'Common Questions' h2 with question sub-headings (h3) each followed by an answer paragraph (p), then a contact call-to-action card containing the 'Contact Support' primary button
author_notes: SWAP: original candidate Cardoso-topdev__react-tailwind-template rejected (CRA 3.4.1 + node-sass 4.14.1 native binary -> fails offline install/build on Node 22). Chose robbins23__daisyui-admin-dashboard-template (CRA 5.0.1, no sass, tailwind3+daisyui+heroicons, react-router 6.4.3, homepage empty -> no basename). Scheme A: baseline /faq = empty route element={<></>} (+ faq in PUBLIC_ROUTES) so it renders a blank #root instead of redirecting to /login via the catch-all Navigate; reference fully implements the FAQ page; bad renders header+topic cards only, omitting the entire Common Questions Q&A list + Contact Support CTA (fails dom_assertions on the h3 questions / answer p / Common Questions h2 / Contact Support button). GOTCHA: checkAuth() in src/app/auth.js hard-redirects window.location.href='/login' for any route not in PUBLIC_ROUTES -> MUST add 'faq' to PUBLIC_ROUTES in reference AND baseline AND bad. No basename (homepage empty) -> state_plan path = /faq.
